# HYPER JAPAN

> > HYPER JAPAN is a cultural platform celebrating Japanese cuisine, travel destinations, traditional arts, and lifestyle through recipes, tourism guides, and cultural workshops.

The site features authentic and fusion Japanese recipes, travel guides to regions like Sendai and Miyagi Prefecture, and online workshops in traditional arts such as ikebana, sumi-e, and shodo. Content spans from practical cooking tutorials to cultural experiences including onsen destinations and Japanese etiquette.

## Key Topics

- Japanese cuisine and recipes
- Onsen and hot springs
- Sendai and Miyagi Prefecture
- Japanese-British fusion cooking
- Traditional Japanese arts (ikebana, sumi-e, shodo)
- Sushi making techniques
- Winter destinations in Japan
- Tohoku region travel
- Vegetarian Japanese cooking
- Matcha and green tea
- Kamaboko and street food
- Japanese cultural workshops
- Teriyaki and traditional cooking methods

## Japanese Recipes & Cooking

- [Basic Rice](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/basic-rice): Fundamental Japanese rice cooking preparation technique guide
- [Nigirizushi (Finger Sushi)](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/nigirizushi-finger-sushi): Traditional nigirizushi finger sushi making technique and recipe guide
- [Karei no Nitsuke (Simmered Plaice)](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/karei-no-nitsuke-simmered-plaice): Traditional Japanese simmered plaice fish recipe (nitsuke cooking method)
- [Yu-dofu (Simmered Tofu)](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/yu-dofu-simmered-tofu): Simple vegetarian yu-dofu simmered tofu recipe with kombu dashi
- [Teriyaki Chicken with Black Pepper Mayo](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/teriyaki-chicken-with-black-pepper-mayo): Grilled teriyaki chicken thighs with black pepper mayo fusion recipe
- [Garlic Konnyaku](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/garlic-konnyaku): Low-calorie vegetarian garlic konnyaku Japanese snack recipe
- [Sesame Oil Dressing](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/sesame-oil-dressing): Simple Japanese sesame oil salad dressing condiment recipe

## Japanese Fusion & Creative Recipes

- [Japanese-Style Beef and Asparagus Stir-Fry with Horseradish](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/japanese-style-beef-and-asparagus-stir-fry-with-horseradish): British-Japanese fusion beef stir-fry recipe with asparagus and horseradish
- [Wasabi Cream With Smoked Salmon](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/wasabi-cream-with-smoked-salmon): Japanese fusion wasabi cream and smoked salmon appetizer canapé recipe
- [Millennium Dome Sushi](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/millennium-dome-sushi): Award-winning creative sushi recipe by Memi Sumiya from 2003 competition
- [Matcha Green Tea Cupcakes with Sweet Potato Frosting](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/recipe/green-tea-cupcakes-with-sweet-potato-frosting): Japanese-inspired matcha cupcakes with sweet potato frosting dessert recipe

## Travel & Tourism in Japan

- [5 Beautiful Winter Destinations in Japan](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/tourism/5-beautiful-winter-destinations-in-japan): Top 5 winter travel destinations in Japan featuring onsen and ski resorts
- [Take a Hot Spring Soak Among the Autumn Leaves at Akiu Great Falls](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/tourism/take-a-hot-spring-soak-among-the-autumn-leaves-at-akiu-great-falls): Akiu Great Falls onsen experience in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture during autumn
- [Sendai Street Food - Delicious Kamaboko Fishcake Delicacies in Miyagi Prefecture](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/food-drink/sendai-street-food-delicious-kamaboko-fishcake-delicacies-in-miyagi-prefecture): Sendai kamaboko fishcake street food guide featuring Abe Kamaboko-ten

## Traditional Japanese Arts & Workshops

- [Online Ikebana Flower Arrangement Workshop with Ritsuko Yamashita](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/kawaii-fashion/ritsuko_yamashita): Ikenobo school ikebana online workshop with instructor Ritsuko Yamashita
- [Sumi-e & Shodo Online Workshop with Akemi Lucas](https://hyperjapan.co.uk/kawaii-fashion/sumi-painting-online-workshop-of-akemi-lucas): Japanese ink painting and calligraphy online workshop with Akemi Lucas
